prompt: Edit the attached exact LPC pixel sprite strip. Preserve THREE equal square cells in a horizontal row with identical positions and directions: down/front, right profile, back. Same male sect leader with silver-gray pixie hair covering part of the forehead, navy tied headband with narrow tails in the back, ivory/light-gray crossover robe, navy sash, charcoal trousers, brown slippers with white trim. Draw only a tiny courteous chin-down nod: head, hair and headband/tails move as one continuous shape about ONE logical pixel lower. Preserve original head size, silhouette, body proportions, simple crisp LPC pixel grid and source colors. Every body pixel below collar including sleeves, hands, waist, trousers and feet remains stationary and faithful to reference. No redesign, new accessory, weapon, text, label, shadow, floor or base. Transparent background, same generous margins and 3:1 proportions as the 768x256 reference. A minor dialogue response pose, not attack or spell.
